title: 27 September 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
This was the eighth date on which The Beatles performed both lunchtime and evening shows at Liverpool’s Cavern Club.

The group’s lunchtime shows typically lasted from 12-2pm. This was their 41st lunchtime show, and their 57th appearance overall at the underground venue on Mathew Street.

Although the precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows. Their final performance at the venue took place on 3 August 1963.
